description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waradala, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land and property matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
